name: mods/alomare/stratagems_unleashed
description: Pick the same stratagem more than once in the Hellpod loadout, vehicles included (two of the same mech, FRV or tank). Only your game is changed; teammates don't need the mod. After a game update it looks for the game code it needs; if that code changed, it turns itself off and the loadout works as normal.
requires: Bingus Shared Loader v17 or newer
